payload.description_html:
The skull of Zupaysaurus rougieri (A) in right lateral view. Scale bar equals 5 cm. Cropped from Figure 2 in the source.
  • anfe - antorbital fenestra
  • emf - external mandibular fenestra
  • itf - infratemporal fenestra
  • or - orbit
